children.alt: Meetily vs Otter.ai - Privacy-First Meeting Transcription

children.text: Otter.ai is a cloud-based meeting transcription and note-taking service from AI Sense Inc., founded in 2016 by Sam Liang and Yun Fu. It joins meetings on Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams as the OtterPilot bot, captures real-time transcripts with speaker labels, and generates AI summaries and action items. It targets sales, recruiting, education, and general business users, and operates on a freemium SaaS model with paid plans roughly in the $8.33-$30/user/month range billed annually.

Meetily takes a different architectural approach to the same workflow. Rather than sending audio to a cloud service, Meetily Community runs Whisper-based transcription locally on Windows or macOS, so audio and transcripts stay on your device. Summaries are pluggable - you can keep them local or bring your own API key. Community is free and open source under MIT; Pro is $10/user/month billed annually for premium support. If you'd like to try the local-first model, download Meetily at /downloads.
Free Community edition with Pro support available. Join users who chose privacy over cloud convenience.
Key Differences: Local vs Cloud Processing
See how Meetily's privacy-first approach compares to Otter.ai's cloud model
Meetily: All transcription happens on your device. Your data never leaves your control. Otter.ai: Sends all audio to external cloud servers for processing and storage.
Meetily: Free for individual use (open source). Organizations & Enterprise: Custom pricing. Otter.ai: $8.33-$30/month per user ($100-360/year) for everyone.
Meetily: MIT licensed, full source code access, no vendor lock-in. Otter.ai: Closed source, proprietary algorithms, limited customization.
Meetily: GDPR/HIPAA compliant by design, zero data transmission. Otter.ai: Requires trusting third-party cloud security and privacy policies.
Meetily: Works completely offline, no internet required. Otter.ai: Requires constant internet connectivity for all transcription functionality.
Meetily: Scale to any team size at zero cost. Otter.ai: Per-user pricing ($20-30/month) makes large team deployment expensive.

children.q: What is Meetily and how is it different from Otter.ai?
children.a: Meetily is an open source AI meeting assistant that processes everything locally on your device. Unlike Otter.ai which stores data in the cloud, Meetily ensures 100% privacy with no external data transmission. Key differences: 100% Local Processing (vs cloud-based), Free (vs $8-30/month), Open Source (vs proprietary), GDPR/HIPAA Compliant by Design (vs limited compliance).

children.q: Is Meetily really free compared to Otter.ai?
children.a: Yes, Meetily Community edition is free and open source (MIT license) with no subscription fees or usage limits. Pro is $10/user/month billed annually ($120/year) for enhanced features. Enterprise deployments have custom pricing. Otter.ai charges $8.33-$30/month per user for everyone. Community users save $96-360+ per year with Meetily.

children.q: Which is better for privacy: Meetily or Otter.ai?
children.a: Meetily is significantly better for privacy. All data processing happens locally on your device with no external transmission. Otter.ai processes and stores all your meeting data in the cloud. For GDPR, HIPAA, or any privacy-sensitive use case, Meetily provides complete data sovereignty while Otter.ai requires trusting third-party cloud processing.

children.q: Can Meetily transcribe as accurately as Otter.ai?
children.a: Yes, Meetily uses state-of-the-art speech recognition models (Whisper) that provide accuracy comparable to or better than Otter.ai, especially for technical discussions and specialized terminology. The advantage is that all processing happens locally, so your data never leaves your control.

children.q: Does Meetily work offline like Otter.ai requires internet?
children.a: Yes, Meetily can work completely offline since all processing happens locally on your device. Otter.ai requires constant internet connectivity as it sends audio to cloud servers for processing. This makes Meetily ideal for secure environments or situations with limited connectivity.

children.q: How does cost compare over time between Meetily and Otter.ai?
children.a: Over 5 years: Meetily Community edition costs $0 (free), Otter.ai Pro costs $500 ($8.33/month), Otter.ai Business costs $1,200 ($20/month), and Otter.ai Enterprise costs $1,800 ($30/month). Community users save $500-1,800 over 5 years. Meetily Pro is $10/user/month billed annually ($120/year).

children.q: Can I migrate my data from Otter.ai to Meetily?
children.a: Yes, you can export your existing transcripts from Otter.ai before switching to Meetily. While the formats may differ, you can import or reference your historical data. Going forward, all new meetings will be processed and stored locally with Meetily, giving you complete control.

children.q: Is Meetily suitable for enterprise teams like Otter.ai?
children.a: Yes, Meetily is enterprise-ready with features like self-hosted deployment, GDPR/HIPAA compliance by design, complete data sovereignty, and unlimited user scaling. Unlike Otter.ai which charges per user ($20-30/month), Meetily Community is free and Pro is $10/user/month. Enterprise has custom pricing.
